rules.statement: A purchaser of property that had been let is bound by the lease and must allow the lessee to continue in occupation until the end of the term unless the lessee cancels or surrenders the lease.
rules.supporting_quote: 'Hire goes before sale', or 'dot Huur voor Koop gaat ', is an axiom of our law, and purchasers of, and persons succeeding to the possession of landed property, are bound by the leases previously made by the vendors. From this arises the privilege of the tenant, either to remain the tenant of the new landlord, the purchaser, or to cancel the lease.
